title: nestegg — private net worth tracker
metaDescription: Track your net worth privately — log your assets each year and watch your wealth over time and by allocation. Encrypted in your browser; no email, no password, just an account number.
sub: A quiet accounting of what you hold and what you earn — encrypted in your browser before it ever leaves. No email, no password. Just an account number only you know.
demo: Just looking? Explore a live demo — no account needed.
note: Free · no sign-up form · works on every device
f1p: Your figures are encrypted on your device with a key derived from your account number. The server only ever stores ciphertext — it can't read a thing.
f2p: Log your assets each year and watch your wealth grow, broken down by allocation. Stocks priced live, foreign currencies converted at the right historical rate.
f3p: Track every month's net pay for you and your partner side by side, with raises and job changes marked, and a combined yearly trend.
f4p: Mortgages and car loans with real amortization — extra payments, rate-fixed periods, depreciation — so the equity in your net worth is always accurate.
f5p: Pick up where you left off on any device. Everything syncs end-to-end encrypted — and Export JSON gives you a backup that's truly your own.
f6p: No email, no password, no profile. We never see who you are — just an opaque hash and an encrypted blob. Nothing to harvest, nothing to sell.
mcpH: 99 finance calculators, as an MCP server
mcpP: The same money math powers a free, open Model Context Protocol server and JSON API — loans & mortgages, time value of money, investing & risk, bonds, options, retirement, real estate, business, tax, and everyday money. Exact German net-salary math for 2023–2026 is built in, verified against the official BMF test tables. It's a stateless remote service — your inputs are used to compute a result and then discarded, never stored.
finalP: You'll get an account number — write it down, it's the only way back in. Then watch your wealth take shape.
